{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
num_qa_orders = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of QA orders: {num_qa_orders}')

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
# Keep only completed orders that are not QA
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')]
num_valid_orders = len(filtered_df)
print(f'Total valid orders after filtering: {num_valid_orders}')

# Compute average revenue per converted order for each channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()
print("Average revenue per converted order by channel:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rate_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conversion_rate_by_channel)"}
